name: _mixins.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _mixins.scss — Sass-only helpers: decimal-round, to-rem() unit conversion,
//  and the layout-{320..4096} breakpoint mixins used everywhere for responsive
//  design. None of these emit CSS by themselves.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// MIXINS
// Decimal Round

/// Rounds a number to N decimal digits using the given rounding mode.
/// `round`/`floor` wrap in calc() so the result stays a math expression
/// Sass can still compose; `ceil` returns a plain number (Sass has no
/// native CSS ceil() at this pinned Sass version).
/// Non-number inputs warn and pass through unchanged instead of failing
/// the whole compile — a typo in one call site shouldn't kill the build.
/// @param {Number} $number - Value to round.
/// @param {Number} $digits [0] - Decimal places to keep (must be unitless).
/// @param {String} $mode [round] - `round`, `ceil`, or `floor`.
/// @return {Number} The rounded value (or the input when invalid).
@function decimal-round($number, $digits: 0, $mode: round) {
  $n: 1;
  // $number must be a number
  @if type-of($number) != number {
    @warn '#{ $number } is not a number.';
    @return $number;
  }

  // $digits must be a unitless number
  @if type-of($digits) != number {
    @warn '#{ $digits } is not a number.';
    @return $number;
  } @else if not unitless($digits) {
    @warn '#{ $digits } has a unit.';
    @return $number;
  }

  @if $digits > 0 {
    @for $i from 1 through $digits {
      $n: $n * 10;
    }
  }

  @if $mode == round {
    @return calc(round($number * $n) / $n);
  } @else if $mode == ceil {
    @return ceil($number * $n) / $n;
  } @else if $mode == floor {
    @return calc(floor($number * $n) / $n);
  } @else {
    @warn '#{ $mode } is undefined keyword.';
    @return $number;
  }
}

/// Converts a px length to a vw percentage of a reference viewport.
/// @param {Number} $value - Length in px.
/// @param {Number} $viewport - Reference viewport width in px.
/// @return {String} A `vw`-suffixed value rounded to 3 decimals.
@function to-vw($value, $viewport) {
  @return #{decimal-round((($value / $viewport) * 100), 3)}vw;
}

/// Converts a px length to a vmin percentage of a reference height.
/// @param {Number} $value - Length in px.
/// @param {Number} $height - Reference height in px.
/// @return {String} A `vmin`-suffixed value rounded to 3 decimals.
@function to-vmin($value, $height) {
  @return #{decimal-round((($value / $height) * 100), 3)}vmin;
}

/// Converts a px (or unitless px-meaning) number to rem at the 16px root.
/// The px unit is stripped first so `to-rem(16px)` and `to-rem(16)` both
/// yield 1rem — Fibonacci $space-* tokens are declared unitless.
/// @param {Number} $value - px length or unitless px count.
/// @return {String} A `rem`-suffixed value rounded to 3 decimals.
@function to-rem($value) {
  // Strip px unit if present so the result is always unitless before appending rem
  @if unit($value) == 'px' {
    $value: calc($value / 1px);
  }

  @return #{decimal-round((calc($value / 16)), 3)}rem;
}

// Calculate percentual value related to the given area

/// Expresses $value as a percentage of $area (e.g. a slot inside a grid cell).
/// @param {Number} $value - Part length.
/// @param {Number} $area - Whole length.
/// @return {Number} Percentage rounded to 3 decimals.
@function rel-to-area($value, $area) {
  @return #{decimal-round((($value / $area) * 100%), 3)};
}

/// Neutralizes <br> inside the scope — `content: ' '` collapses the line
/// break (and the generated content) so copy with <br> can be flattened
/// on narrow layouts without editing the markup.
@mixin ignore-br() {
  br {
    content: ' ';

    &:after {
      content: ' ';
    }
  }
}

// Create Pseudo Elements

/// Emits the content/display/position triplet for a pseudo-element.
/// @param {String} $display [block] - display value.
/// @param {String} $pos [absolute] - position value.
/// @param {String} $content [''] - content value.
@mixin pseudo($display: block, $pos: absolute, $content: '') {
  content: $content;
  display: $display;
  position: $pos;
}

// Typography

/// Sets a unitless-proportional line-height in rem — lh/fs rounded to 2
/// decimals so the rhythm stays proportional when font-size is tweaked.
/// @param {Number} $font-size - Font size in the same unit as $line-height.
/// @param {Number} $line-height - Desired line height.
@mixin proportional-line($font-size, $line-height) {
  line-height: decimal-round($line-height / $font-size, 2) * 1rem;
}

// Reset list

/// Removes list chrome (markers + box offsets).
/// @param {Number} $padding [0] - Padding to keep.
/// @param {Number} $margin [0] - Margin to keep.
@mixin reset-list($padding: 0, $margin: 0) {
  margin: $margin;
  padding: $padding;
  list-style-type: none;
}

// Media Queries
// Each layout-N mixin wraps @content in `min-width: $bk-N` — the $bk-*
// tokens are (vw − 1px) so a "layout-540" rule lands just below the 540px
// device class, matching the design-grid steps.

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-320)` — iPhone-SE-class portrait.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-320 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-320}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-375)` — standard iPhone portrait.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-375 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-375}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-414)` — phablet portrait.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-414 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-414}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-540)` — mobile-menu/phablet breakpoint.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-540 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-540}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-768)` — iPad portrait.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-768 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-768}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-960)` — tablet landscape.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-960 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-960}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-1024)` — iPad landscape / small laptop.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-1024 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-1024}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-1280)` — HD laptop.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-1280 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-1280}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-1360)` — HD laptop (common 1366 class).
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-1360 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-1360}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-1440)` — HD+ laptop.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-1440 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-1440}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-1560)` — wide HD laptop.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-1560 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-1560}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-1680)` — wide desktop.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-1680 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-1680}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-1920)` — FHD desktop.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-1920 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-1920}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-2560)` — 2K/QHD.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-2560 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-2560}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-3840)` — 4K/UHD.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-3840 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-3840}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-5120)` — 5K.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-5120 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-5120}) {
    @content;
  }
}

/// `@media (min-width: $bk-7680)` — 8K.
/// @content Rules to emit inside the query.
@mixin layout-7680 {
  @media (min-width: #{$bk-7680}) {
    @content;
  }
}

// Iterates every $grid-steps breakpoint, emitting one min-width media query
// per step (matching the layout-N mixins' `$bk-* = vw − 1px` semantics).
// @content receives ($step, $gap, $cols) so %MAXAREA and the show-grid
// overlay share the exact same breakpoint→gutter table — add a step to
// $grid-steps and BOTH update together.

/// Emits one `min-width: (step−1)px` media query per `$grid-steps` entry.
/// Steps ≤ 272 are skipped — the watch viewport is the base (un-queried)
/// layout. Keeping a single iteration point guarantees %MAXAREA gutters
/// and the debug overlay can never drift apart.
/// @content Receives `($step, $gap, $cols)` per breakpoint.
@mixin grid-steps {
  @each $step, $gap in $grid-steps {
    @if $step > 272 {
      @media (min-width: #{$step - 1}px) {
        @content ($step, $gap, map-get($grid-cols, $step));
      }
    }
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring — a crisp hairline + offset, inked by the theme-aware
// --focus-ring token (deep teal light / signature cyan dark). Emits
// declarations only — nest under `&:focus-visible` at the call site.

/// Emits the focus-ring declarations (outline + offset) — nest under
/// `&:focus-visible`. Inked by `--focus-ring` so the affordance matches
/// the theme accent in both light and dark.
@mixin focus-ring {
  outline: to-rem($space-2xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
  outline-offset: to-rem($space-2xs);
}

// Emits the ring for every tabbable element in scope — component stylesheets
// pull this in so shadow-DOM interactives get the same affordance as light
// DOM (document-level rules never cross the shadow boundary). tabindex=-1
// targets are programmatically-focused containers, not controls.

/// Emits `:focus-visible` rules for every tabbable element type in the
/// current scope — component sheets pull this in because document-level
/// focus rules never pierce shadow DOM. `[tabindex='-1']` is excluded:
/// those are programmatically-focused containers, not controls.
@mixin focus-ring-scope {
  a:focus-visible,
  button:focus-visible,
  input:focus-visible,
  select:focus-visible,
  textarea:focus-visible,
  summary:focus-visible,
  [role='button']:focus-visible,
  [role='switch']:focus-visible,
  [role='slider']:focus-visible,
  [tabindex]:not([tabindex='-1']):focus-visible {
    @include focus-ring;
  }
}
